notes.title: 🎉 The Demo is Live! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We’re excited to announce that the Few Shall Return Demo is now available to play on Steam! 🚀

This demo gives you a first taste of what we’ve been building, and we can’t wait to hear what you think. Here’s what you can expect in this version:


✨ Key Features in the Demo
Explore the dungeon and try the combat system

Meet some of the early characters

Experience the first puzzle to unlock the inner dungeon

Not everyone leaves: fight for a chance to escape

Your feedback during this stage means the world to us—it will help us polish the game and shape what comes next. Please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts in the on our Discord.


🔓 How is the demo different than the full game?
There's only one map in the demo. The full game has an infinite number of maps because they are procedurally generated.

You can only play with others through invite codes in the demo. In the full game, you can also join random matches through matchmaking.


⚡ What’s Next?
We’ll continue updating the demo and adding content as we work toward the full release. The next Demo update is planned for Sept 26.

Thank you for checking out the demo and supporting our journey. We hope you enjoy your first adventure in Few Shall Return! 💙



-- The Ballard Games Team
